txt.si_l:
1. Submit your trade-in. | Fill out our trade-in form with photos of your bike and select the shipping option.

2. Get an initial offer. | We'll review your submission and send an estimated trade-in value by email and text.

3. Pack and ship. | Local bike shops can pack and ship the bike. You'll pay the shipping cost upfront, keep the receipt and take photos of the packed bike before sealing the box.

4. Inspection. | We'll inspect its condition and confirm your final offer. If the offer differs from our initial estimate, we'll explain why before you decide whether to proceed.

5. Shipping cost reimbursed. | Shipping expense will be added to your trade-in value, whether you choose credit toward another bike or cash payment.
txt.t_n: We usually reply within 1 hour on business days.
txt.si_n: Estimates are approximate and the final offer is made after inspection. If you decide not to accept the final offer, we are unable to cover return shipping, so the bike would be sent back at your cost.
txt.so_h: Why We Don't Have a Storefront
txt.visit_note: Meetings by appointment via our simple form.
txt.so_l:
We're focused on keeping bike prices as low as possible. | By operating without the overhead of a traditional retail storefront, we can pass those savings on to our customers.

Our inventory is stored across multiple secure locations,| helping us keep operating costs and risks low while offering better value to both buyers and sellers.
txt.so_n: No expensive storefront. Less overhead. Better prices.
txt.intro: Fair, competitive pricing backed by daily market data.
